verdict.rationale: Ramp documents card spend, bill pay, procurement, ERP sync, and treasury/banking (checking + investment accounts) as a single consolidated platform, with customer proof points (Studs replaced 4 tools; AIRCO onboarded in 1 week vs 6 months) and community corroboration that the card/expense flow works well end-to-end. missing for 10: independent third-party case studies beyond vendor-published testimonials, and hands-on community confirmation specifically of bill pay/banking consolidation (only card/expense use is corroborated in community evidence).
